design_relevant_readme: ctt 2a/2b/2c assigned access to crowd information year1; 1a/1b/1c individual; IFP date_start/suspend/closed and forecast type categories
instrument: Official Dataverse DDI XML metadata API only, do not download microdata rows or demographics distributions
measure: DDI response code, SHA256 of metadata bytes, variable names only, number of observations if available
presence of ctt, user_id, ifp_id, forecast time, outcome, visibility/view/page impression, feedback assignment names
do not infer ctt randomization from label
do not print raw values of any person
control file with no DDI should return not available, not a success
outcome_gate: If no independent per-person pre-response visibility events, STOP_R5 for target causal effect; no legacy AB-H consumption

runner_limits.network: official Dataverse HTTPS only, no authentication
